name: watch-deck
body: Watch deck: watch deck files (slides/, assets/, kalide.yaml) and the RESOLVED library's structure (the configured `templates:` path when set, else the local `templates/` — its library.yaml and its slides/, sections/, themes/, media/ subtrees are its structure, and any other top-level entry in the library root is inert; see library-guide-layout), debounce, publish deck-changed; on change reload templates→validate→render and publish deck-rebuilt. A change to the configured `templates:` value keeps the session's startup-pinned library root and publishes the full-page restart-required error (see template-retarget-requires-restart, global.constraint.never-serve-broken-deck).
